ratings.skill_rule: >= 20 resolved raises, mean 63-session excess vs SPY > 0, resolved before the decision date

insider.pit: observed_at_utc (filing date EOD, conservative) strictly before the decision day
insider.caveat: the file ends at its last observed date; windows after it undercount

eightk.pit: counts: acceptance day strictly before the decision day; the 3-day announcement return is used only once its last session has closed

short_interest.basis: shortintadj (split-adjusted) over split-adjusted bar volume: both on the current share basis, so the ratio carries no split look-ahead
short_interest.caveat: gvkey->symbol by CURRENT Compustat ticker; dead issuers mostly absent

sector.caveat: CURRENT classification applied to every past month (static map)

inst_breadth_chg.pit: rdate + 45d strictly before the date (fdate == rdate)

is_opex_week.reading: 0 month-end rows in an opex week = the monthly engine cannot hold opex_week_large_hold (engine mismatch, measured)

mkt_value.identity: DATED_CCM_LINK (lnkhist gvkey<->permno by date, stocknames permno->ticker as of the row's date; then the last CRSP ticker; then the current tic for post-2024 renames)
mkt_value.pit: Compustat anchor available at rdq + 2d strictly before the date; rolled by adj_close ratio
mkt_value.gap: Compustat fundq on disk ends datadate 2024-12-31: NaN from 2026-04-06 (MV_STALE_DAYS 460)

short_volume.pit_rule: a day's FINRA file is public after that day's close (~17:20 ET, CDN last-modified); a decision on day D reads only files dated STRICTLY BEFORE D (usable from the NEXT session)

extension.pit: features at t+1d from rows dated <= t, mapped back to t

objective.primary_sort: sealed_vs_spy = the 2024-26 selection window (split declared, data seen): net CAGR minus SPY CAGR, same months. A SORT, not a holdout -- the out-of-sample read is `dev_selected_sealed_evaluated`
objective.split_rule: a period belongs to the window its ENTRY session (decision + 1 business day) is in
objective.honest_note: The 2024-26 selection window (split declared, data seen) is 32 monthly blocks. The split was declared in code before this run; nobody's eyes were closed to 2024-2026: every rule was written in 2026, and the 02:00 board printed full-sample numbers including it. Ranking 877 cells on 32 months selects luck as readily as skill -- read sealed_dsr (at n=877), the dev column, and `dev_selected_sealed_evaluated` (rules picked on dev only, read on 2024-26).

spy.alignment: daily total return compounded over (month-end, next month-end]

iwm.alignment: daily total return compounded over (month-end, next month-end]

benchmarks.note: vs_X = the rule's net CAGR minus X's CAGR over the SAME monthly periods of the window; random_panel = mean monthly net series of random_1, random_2, random_3 at k=50; IWM = total return from the cached ETF series on the factory's month-end grid
benchmarks.order: two-pass: the random panel first, then every rule
